line.token: * Manages client credit balances with atomic operations and full audit trail.
* Supports "up-front asset credit" billing product where clients pre-pay for hardware.
* ARCHITECTURE NOTE: Credits are BILLING data (not CRM), so this service lives in PIB module.
* Credits are stored in client_credits table with balance_cents column for atomic operations.
* CRITICAL: All credit operations use AtomicCounterService to prevent race conditions.
* - Implements CreditWriter for write operations (add, deduct)
* - Implements CreditReader for read operations (getBalance, hasSufficientCredit)
* - Implements CreditLedgerInterface for backward compatibility (will be deprecated)
* Consumers should depend on the specific interface they need:
* - Need to modify credits? Type-hint CreditWriter
* - Need to read balances? Type-hint CreditReader
* - Need both? Type-hint both or use CreditLedgerInterface (legacy)
* Convert cents to dollars for display
* Add credit to client account (atomic operation)
* @param float $amount Amount to add in dollars (positive)
* @param int|null $userId User who created this credit
* @param \DateTime|null $expiresAt Optional expiration date for the credit
// Record in ledger for audit trail
* Deduct credit from client account (atomic operation)
* @param float $amount Amount to deduct in dollars (positive)
* @param int|null $userId User who created this debit
* @throws \Exception If client not found or insufficient balance
// Record in ledger for audit trail
* Get credit ledger history for a client
* @param int $limit Maximum number of entries to return
* @return array<int, mixed> Array of ledger entries
* Get current credit balance for a client
* @return float Current credit balance in dollars
* Check if client has sufficient credit
* @return bool True if sufficient credit available
